response_mode.description: Opt-in presentation. Omitted/legacy preserves existing output; compact selects evidence; full retains complete evidence with pagination when needed.

output_budget_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte cap for the serialized MCP tool result, including escaped content, excluding JSON-RPC framing. Compact/full only; defaults 12000/80000.
